newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Blue Cross covers Neuromedical test.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Blue Cross covers Neuromedical test.

text.p: Neuromedical Systems Inc said on Monday that it had an agreement with Blue Cross Blue Shield Mutual of Ohio for Blue Cross of Ohio to cover the cost of Neuromedical's PAPNET pap smear test for all members.

The company said that Blue Cross of Ohio had also agreed to strongly recommend to its clinicians and laboratories that all negative Pap smears covered by its benefit plans are to be examined using PAPNET testing.
According to Neuromedical, twelve laboratories, including several major hospitals, currently offer PAPNET testing in Ohio.
